description: Realistic CC0 asset library (Poly Haven). Load with src/gfx/assets.js. Model units are metres (glTF, +Y up); scale_hint is a suggested uniform scale for the game (battle diorama ≈ 1 unit/m with stylised 3–6 m trees; tabletop study ≈ 10 units/m). name#k (or name#nodeName) selects one variant of a set.

conventions.models: assets/models/<name>.glb – self-contained GLB; textures are JPEG (PNG only where alpha is needed); no Draco/KTX2. Geometry uses EXT_meshopt_compression + KHR_mesh_quantization, so load through src/gfx/assets.js (or any GLTFLoader with setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder) from three/addons/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js). Every authored node keeps its transform (variants: top-level children; animatable parts: named nodes, mesh in a child "<name>_mesh"). Material extras: foliage (alpha-cutout cards), glass, flame.
conventions.textures: assets/textures/<set>/{diff,nor,arm}.jpg – diff sRGB; nor OpenGL (+Y) normal map; arm = R ambient occlusion, G roughness, B metalness. repeat_m = real-world size of one tile.
conventions.hdris: assets/hdri/<name>.hdr – 1k equirectangular Radiance HDR; use for PMREM environment light and as the visible sky. sun.dir = unit vector towards the sun in three.js world space for an unrotated sky (EquirectangularReflectionMapping); with scene.backgroundRotation.y = scene.environmentRotation.y = r the sun is at sun.dir rotated by r about +Y (see hdriSunDirection in src/gfx/assets.js).
